endpoints.name: Treatment-goal coverage
endpoints.definition: Satisfied predeclared treatment or escalation requirements / applicable requirements; report critical needs separately.

endpoints.name: Major-error case rate
endpoints.definition: Cases with at least one adjudicated serious or potentially life-threatening prescribing error / cases with an adjudicated major-error status.

endpoints.name: Joint clinically correct order rate
endpoints.definition: Orders with every applicable clinical field correct / assessed generated orders; pair with goal coverage to expose omissions.

endpoints.name: Unnecessary-medication rate
endpoints.definition: Adjudicated unnecessary or unjustified duplicate orders / assessed generated orders; empty output has no order-level rate.

endpoints.name: Required-field completeness
endpoints.definition: Present applicable fields / required fields; report clinical field correctness separately.

endpoints.name: Clinical constraint handling
endpoints.definition: Sensitivity and precision for adjudicated actionable hazards; separately report allergy, interactions, organ adjustment and population restrictions.

endpoints.name: Adjunct and infusion adequacy
endpoints.definition: Supported purpose and correct applicable preparation/volume/rate requirements; extra adjuncts count as unnecessary orders.

endpoints.name: Monitoring-plan coverage
endpoints.definition: Satisfied required follow-up targets, times and action criteria / applicable monitoring requirements.

endpoints.name: Applicable-evidence support
endpoints.definition: Clinically material claims supported by the cited source and correct product/population/time context / assessed claims; retrieval availability is separate.

endpoints.name: Appropriate disposition
endpoints.definition: Correct prescribe/renew/withhold/request-information/escalate decisions / assessed cases; pair with action coverage and error rate.

endpoints.name: Reconciliation completeness
endpoints.definition: Correct continue/start/change/stop handling and relevant active/OTC medication reconciliation / applicable requirements.

endpoints.name: Patient feasibility
endpoints.definition: Satisfied administration, access and patient-preference requirements / applicable requirements.

endpoints.name: Clinician edit burden
endpoints.definition: Blinded reviewer edit count and time to an acceptable draft; report medians and dispersion.

endpoints.name: Operational cost and coverage
endpoints.definition: Action rate, unresolved/abstention rate, latency, calls and tokens per case; never optimize an error rate by hiding abstention.

denominator_rules: Freeze patient-need requirements and acceptable alternatives before viewing method outputs.
Unknown applicability and unrated items stay explicit; no zero-denominator perfect scores.
Report assessment coverage with every score and patient-level macro plus opportunity-level micro estimates.
Report action coverage with safety and order rates; medically appropriate withholding can satisfy a predeclared requirement.
Reference drug sets and clinical appropriateness are separate endpoints.

review.blinding: Hide method and checkpoint; randomized/counterbalanced order; independent first ratings retained.
review.disagreements: Discuss after independent ratings; unresolved items remain unknown; retain both ratings.
statistics: Binary agreement and severity-weighted kappa with coverage
Report random and challenge cohorts separately
Preregister multiplicity handling for confirmatory testing of three primary endpoints

severity.0: No identified error within assessed scope
severity.2: Clinically relevant correction needed without serious expected harm
severity.unknown: Insufficient context or unresolved judgment; not zero

software_scope: clinical_metrics.py aggregates adjudicated requirement ratings, major-error labels and unnecessary-order labels. It does not create clinical labels, hazard matching, edit times, confidence intervals or kappa.

dataset.task: Complete prescription drafts at a declared decision time
dataset.inputs: Recorded availability; exclude post-decision facts and target orders from actor context
dataset.roster: Not yet sampled; check against historical exposure registry and freeze before output scoring
dataset.historical_reuse: Label as exploratory if prior exposure cannot be excluded
dataset.qa_boundary: Public RxSafeBench/RxQA questions do not provide complete-order clinical labels
